summary: KREIS (Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society) Teacher Recruitment 2026
intro: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has published the KREIS Provisional Answer Key 2026 on 22 November 2026 for the KREIS teacher recruitment exam.
Objections can be submitted online only till 25 November 2026, 10:30 AM. A fee is charged per question challenged, and the final key will be released after expert review.

ol: Open the KREIS 2026 section and download the provisional answer key PDF.
Match answers with your responses to estimate your score.
Use the online objection link to challenge a question and pay the fee.

faq: When was the KEA KREIS answer key released?
What is the last date for KREIS objections?
Is there a fee for objections?
Yes, a fee is charged per question challenged.
final: Download the KREIS provisional answer key, check your score and raise objections before the deadline if needed.
